title: Reset password is not working
body:
I force stop AAPS. I put the PasswordReset file in AAPS\Extra directory. Restart of AAPS does not delete the PasswordReset file and the password cannot be reset.

This was working some time ago.

![Screenshot_20221206_091811_AAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/206041794-b6c1e5e7-020b-433c-8257-18226e314253.jpg)

comments.body:
Same issue experience here on a live release of AAPS 3.1.0.3, 
Build 1de236a602-2022 10.29-14:46
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version 14.2.6

Steps followed as described by @robertrub including forcestop, PasswordReset file placed in AAPS/extra directoy. No passowrd prompt, and the PasswordReset file remains live in the directory. I tried with a space between the words Password and Reset, as well, to make sure, but to no avail.
![Screenshot_20221206-103225_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/117252917/206084512-920c95ad-23c6-4533-b099-052727d847c5.jpg)
No, it is not. It stays in the _extra_ directory.

right. it was not working for all pumps
fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/cd7832a6e168725ecfdbac8e398deca3055031fe
